snippet.title: CONCUBINE Dark Fantasy ARPG Game Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter a world of forbidden desire and ruthless power in Concubine – a dark fantasy hack & slash ARPG. Wishlist now on Steam to be notified of Early Access.

🔹 Key Features
  • Deep Character Customization — Full face & body sliders (eyes, nose, jaw, height, weight, muscle, breast & butt shape, skin tones, makeup) with HD skin rendering moles and veins visible.
  • Brutal, Skill-Based Combat — Timing, positioning and weapon mastery (one-hand, two-hand, dual wield, polearm behavior, bows, special attacks).
  • Companion System — Rescue, equip and customize up to 3 companions; companions live in your palace and fight by your side.
  • Hub & Palace Life — Buy & place Ottoman-inspired furniture, decorate a Harem, scene/preset photo mode & free-pose tools.
  • Procedural Instances & Exploration — Galata, Basilica Cistern, Yedikule, Rumeli Fortress, crypts — randomized layouts, loot and boss encounters.
 • Dynamic Loot & Economy — Visual/statistical item variance, vendor inventory shifts and balanced rewards.

🔗 Wishlist / Follow: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2426120/Concubine

🔗 Discord Community: https://discord.com/invite/concubine
